title: hieracium lachenalii subsp. tortifolium
intro: Hieracium lachenalii subsp. tortifolium, commonly known as a species of hawkweed, is a plant that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestive issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy of Hieracium lachenalii subsp. tortifolium for therapeutic purposes.
